column1: # Format (tab-separated): category, installed-name, source-repo, path-in-repo, upstream-name
#   source-repo     key into the repository table in tools/install-skills.sh
#   path-in-repo    directory copied out of that repository (copied verbatim except .git)
#   upstream-name   original frontmatter name: rewritten to installed-name when different
# Nothing from these repositories is executed during install. Files are only cloned and copied.
# Exact commits are recorded in tools/skills.lock by the installer.
